description: Dion Waniandy alleges police officer illegally seized phone, deleted video.

chips.text: Waniandy asked if an investigation would occur against the officer.

description: Police conducted joint traffic and human trafficking enforcement.
Operation found illicit tobacco and identified suspected labor trafficking.
Saskatoon Police promote online criminal record checks for residents.

chips.text: Hockey associations and coaches for criminal record checks.

description: Committee recommends securing 4 acres in Holmwood for a future police station.
Land could also house a fire hall and transit hub.
This is an in-principle approval, not for construction.

chips.text: SPS would be responsible for land compensation, to be determined.
Chief noted other cities expanded police stations around 500k population.
Holmwood area projected to grow by 77,000 residents.
This sets a precedent for proactive land acquisition for future civic services.

description: Recommends 2.5% salary increase for SPS out-of-scope staff in 2027.
